learnPageFormBusiness.overview:
In this step, you will be able to create your new business!

 This online application will allow you to:

 - Register your business name, and
- Form your business with the New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES) 

This form will take about 5-10 minutes to complete.

At the end of the process, you will get your Entity ID immediately after payment is received (sometimes referred to as "NJ Corporation Number," the Entity ID is a 10 digit number used to identify your corporate records.
learnPageFormBusiness.firstSection:
### First, you will check the availability and register the name of your business

Our tool will allow you to check if your preferred business name is available. If it is, you can register it and move to the next steps and start forming your business!
learnPageFormBusiness.secondSection:
### Second, you will form your business

We'll guide you through each step to create and register your business. You'll need:

**Business Designator:** How your business structure is displayed after your business name.

**Effective Date:** Choose a start date for your business. You can pick a future date or start today.

Some optional info will include primary business address, the business purpose, and provisions and articles.
learnPageFormBusiness.moreInfo:
## More info you will need

:::largeCallout{ showHeader="true" headerText="Registered Agent" calloutType="conditional" amountIconText="" filingTypeIconText="" frequencyIconText="" phoneIconText="" phoneIconLabel="" emailIconText="" }

The person who receives legal and tax documents for your business. This can be you! You will need:

* A postal address
* An email address

You can add members (co-owners) and signers (authorized representatives).

:::



:::largeCallout{ showHeader="true" headerText="Billing Information" calloutType="informational" amountIconText="" filingTypeIconText="" frequencyIconText="" phoneIconText="" phoneIconLabel="" emailIconText="" }

You will enter your payment details.

The minimum cost is $100 plus small fees. You'll receive:

* Your formation document
* Your 10-digit Entity ID (needed for state taxes and other official purposes)

You can also purchase:

* Certificate of Good Standing
* Certified copies of your formation document

Review and pay. Once payment is complete, your New Jersey business is official!

:::

:::largeCallout{ showHeader="true" headerText="Offline Registration" calloutType="quickReference" amountIconText="" filingTypeIconText="" frequencyIconText="" phoneIconText="" phoneIconLabel="" emailIconText="" }

If you reserved your business name using the paper form UNRR-1, you must finish forming your business by mail. Learn more here.

:::
